name: Radon Number of Universal Class
proof: Write the hypotheses as $u_i(A)=1$ exactly when $i\in A$, for $A\subseteq[n]$.  For every subset $T\subseteq[n]$, the one-point positive sample at $A=T$ has version space exactly $\{u_i:i\in T\}$.  Hence every subset of hypotheses is convex, every convex hull is the set itself, and all $n$ hypotheses form a Radon-independent set.  The cardinality bound gives equality.
